Name: Luminous Globe 3D Wooden Puzzle
ShortDescription: Rotating wooden globe with gears and warm LED lighting for display.
LongDescription: A beautifully engineered wooden globe featuring a visible gear system that powers smooth rotation. The integrated LED lighting adds a warm ambient glow, making it both a mechanical marvel and a decorative centerpiece for any room.

Name: Steam Engine Mechanical 3D Wooden Puzzle
ShortDescription: Detailed steam engine model with moving pistons and crankshaft parts.
LongDescription: This detailed wooden model recreates the power of a vintage steam locomotive with fully visible pistons and crankshaft movement. Designed for advanced builders, it offers a rewarding assembly experience and a striking mechanical display.

Name: Pendulum Clock Wooden Mechanical Puzzle
ShortDescription: Functional wooden clock featuring exposed gears and moving parts.
LongDescription: A precision-crafted wooden clock that showcases its inner workings through exposed gears. Combining functionality with craftsmanship, this model provides both a practical timepiece and an engaging mechanical build.

Name: Skyrail Marble Run
ShortDescription: Hand-cranked marble run with continuous motion and looping tracks.
LongDescription: An interactive marble run powered by a hand-crank mechanism that continuously cycles marbles through a dynamic track. This model highlights motion and engineering principles while providing an engaging hands-on experience.

Name: Velocity Racer Car
ShortDescription: Rubber-band powered wooden race car built for speed and simplicity.
LongDescription: A sleek wooden race car powered by a rubber-band motor, designed for quick assembly and fun performance. Its lightweight structure and smooth motion make it ideal for beginners and younger builders.

Name: Nordic Dragon Longship
ShortDescription: Viking-inspired longship with engraved wooden panels and detail.
LongDescription: Inspired by traditional Viking longships, this model features intricate engravings and a bold silhouette. It offers a balance of historical design and satisfying construction, resulting in a display-worthy centerpiece.

Name: Seahaven Barque
ShortDescription: Detailed sailing ship with layered decks and intricate rigging work.
LongDescription: A highly detailed sailing vessel complete with layered decks and intricate rigging. This challenging build rewards patience with a stunning nautical model ideal for collectors and enthusiasts.

Name: Sailing Ship Model 3D Wooden Puzzle
ShortDescription: Large wooden warship with multi-deck design and ornate details.
LongDescription: This grand war galleon features multiple decks, detailed cannons, and ornate woodwork. Designed for experienced builders, it captures the scale and elegance of historic naval vessels.

Name: Harbor Tugboat
ShortDescription: Compact tugboat model with simple build and charming design details.
LongDescription: A compact and charming tugboat model that emphasizes simplicity and detail. Its approachable build makes it perfect for beginners while still delivering an attractive finished piece.

Name: Orbital Explorer Shuttle
ShortDescription: Futuristic space shuttle with display stand and moving components.
LongDescription: A futuristic shuttle model with a detailed structure and a themed launch stand. This advanced build highlights engineering complexity and is ideal for space and STEM enthusiasts.

Name: Galactic Rover
ShortDescription: Mars-style rover model with articulated wheels and rugged frame.
LongDescription: Designed after planetary exploration vehicles, this rover features articulated wheels and a rugged frame. It offers an engaging build and a dynamic finished model suitable for display.

Name: Dragonfire Siege Engine
ShortDescription: Medieval-style ballista with working firing mechanism included.
LongDescription: A fantasy-inspired siege engine with a working firing mechanism that launches small projectiles. This model blends mechanical action with imaginative design for a fun and interactive experience.

Name: Arcane Codex Box
ShortDescription: Puzzle box with hidden locking system and secret compartments inside.
LongDescription: A mysterious wooden box featuring a hidden locking mechanism that must be solved to open. Combining puzzle-solving with craftsmanship, it serves as both a brain teaser and a functional storage item.

Name: Grand Windmill Tower
ShortDescription: Rustic windmill tower with rotating blades and gear-driven motion.
LongDescription: A rustic windmill model featuring rotating blades powered by a simple gear system. Its architectural design and motion elements make it both decorative and mechanically interesting.

Name: Parisian Clock Tower
ShortDescription: European-style clock tower with ornate wooden architectural detail.
LongDescription: An elegant clock tower inspired by classic European architecture, featuring detailed facades and structural elements. This model offers a challenging build with a refined final appearance.

Name: Skyline Observation Tower
ShortDescription: Modern observation tower with layered design and structural detail.
LongDescription: A sleek observation tower with a modern, layered construction style. This model emphasizes symmetry and structure, making it a visually striking addition to any collection.

Name: Melody Music Box
ShortDescription: Hand-cranked music box with visible internal moving mechanism.
LongDescription: A decorative music box with a visible internal mechanism that plays a tune when cranked. This simple yet elegant model combines motion, sound, and visual appeal.

Name: Mechanical Butterfly Display
ShortDescription: Decorative butterfly model with flapping wings powered by motion.
LongDescription: A delicate butterfly model that brings motion to life with flapping wings powered by a simple mechanism. Its lightweight design and artistic style make it an eye-catching display piece.

Name: Vintage Camera Model
ShortDescription: Retro camera replica with moving lens and mechanical components.
LongDescription: A nostalgic camera replica featuring a movable lens and mechanical components. This model blends vintage aesthetics with interactive features for a unique building experience.

Name: Illuminated Book Nook Diorama
ShortDescription: Bookshelf insert diorama with lighting and detailed miniature scene.
LongDescription: A miniature diorama designed to fit between books, complete with built-in lighting and intricate details. This model creates a cozy, immersive scene that enhances any bookshelf display.

Name: Atlas Airship
ShortDescription: Retro-futuristic airship with propellers, fins, and display-worthy detail.
LongDescription: The Atlas Airship blends steampunk and science-fiction design with layered wooden panels, rotating propellers, and a suspended display frame. It delivers a challenging build and a distinctive silhouette that stands out in any puzzle collection.

Name: Summit Cable Car
ShortDescription: Mountain cable car model with clean lines and a scenic display base.
LongDescription: This charming cable car kit features a compact build, supporting frame, and a scenic station base inspired by alpine travel. Its approachable assembly makes it a great entry point while still producing a polished display piece.

Name: Runekeeper Treasure Chest
ShortDescription: Locking treasure chest puzzle with engraved panels and hidden storage.
LongDescription: Built around a secret-opening mechanism, this fantasy chest combines decorative rune engravings with functional storage space. It offers a satisfying mix of puzzle-solving, assembly, and finished display appeal.

Name: Midnight Planetarium
ShortDescription: Tabletop planetarium with star cutouts and a soft internal glow effect.
LongDescription: Designed as a decorative astronomy-inspired model, the Midnight Planetarium uses layered wooden shells and light openings to create a warm celestial display. It works especially well as ambient decor on a desk, shelf, or nightstand.

Name: Coastal Lighthouse
ShortDescription: Classic lighthouse display with spiral structure and seaside character.
LongDescription: This lighthouse model captures the charm of coastal architecture with a tiered tower, window detailing, and a textured base. The finished build makes a clean nautical accent while offering a balanced mid-level assembly challenge.

Name: Siege Ram Cart
ShortDescription: Rolling siege ram cart with armored frame and medieval battlefield style.
LongDescription: Inspired by historic siege equipment, this model features a wheeled chassis, reinforced body panels, and a suspended battering ram. The finished piece delivers both motion-focused detail and a strong medieval visual theme.

Name: Polar Research Submarine
ShortDescription: Exploration submarine model with fins, propeller, and layered hull design.
LongDescription: The Polar Research Submarine presents a deep-sea exploration theme with a segmented hull, stabilizing fins, and mechanical propeller details. It is designed for builders who enjoy complex shapes and a more technical final display.

Name: Valewood Carousel
ShortDescription: Decorative carousel with rotating platform and ornate festival styling.
LongDescription: This carousel kit combines graceful structure with motion, using a geared base to rotate the central platform after assembly. Its layered roof, carved details, and whimsical presentation make it one of the most display-friendly models in the catalog.

Name: Longbow Ballista Tower
ShortDescription: Fantasy defense tower with ballista platform and fortified woodwork.
LongDescription: Featuring a raised firing platform, defensive railings, and castle-inspired construction, this kit expands the fantasy lineup with a more architectural build. It offers a detailed silhouette and a strong sense of world-building once completed.

Name: Heritage Tram
ShortDescription: Vintage tramcar model with window detail and classic city transit style.
LongDescription: The Heritage Tram brings old-world street transit to life with a carefully shaped carriage body, detailed window framing, and a nostalgic urban design. It provides a satisfying medium-difficulty build and a distinctive finished profile.
